newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Molnlycke's president sees 7-8 pct margins.
newsitem.headline: Molnlycke's president sees 7-8 pct margins.

text.p: The head of Swedish tissue and diaper producer Molnlycke on Tuesday said he saw future operating margins at around seven-eight percent
"I think seven-eight percent can be a fairly stable level in the future," president Kurth Augustson told a breakfast meeting in the western Swedish town of Gothenburg.
Molnlycke is a subsidiary of Swedish forestry group SCA AB.
In the third quarter of 1996, Molnlycke's operating margin was seven percent which was the latest figure published.

As raw materials are an important factor for profitability, earnings will be negatively affected by 100 million crowns if the price on fluff pulp rises by $100 a tonne from the current level between $500-$600, Augustson said.
Augustson did not, however, expect such a price increase in the near term.
Molnlycke is part of SCA's hygiene products business area, which posted an operating profit of 1.65 billion crowns and sales of 17.89 billion crowns in the first nine months of 1996.
